data_testid_requirement: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case format (e.g. data-testid="run-audit-btn", data-testid="accessibility-score-badge", data-testid="shadow-widget-toggle").

layout_and_bento.landing_hero: Split column or high-impact bento grid featuring live WCAG score gauge (0-100), automated embed snippet generator, and interactive widget sandbox preview.
layout_and_bento.dashboard_grid: High density grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6). Header summary stats (sites, total audits, compliance rate, pending fixes) + Site Cards + Violation Matrix chart + Audit History log.
layout_and_bento.widget_panel: Floating Shadow DOM drawer overlay pinned to bottom-right or bottom-left, z-index 999999, accessible via Alt+A or screen reader prompt.

key_features_to_build: Landing Page with WCAG statistics (96.3% failure rate), live interactive widget preview, instant site scanner demo, and snippet copy.
Auth System with email/password login and register modals/pages.
Dashboard with Site Management: Add domain, generate JavaScript embed script (<script src='.../widget.js' data-site-id='...'></script>).
One-click Audit Runner powered by axe-core in browser/backend: scores 0-100, WCAG 2.1 AA violation classification (Critical, Serious, Moderate, Minor), AI fix suggestions via Gemini.
SEO Audit Integration: checks meta tags, headings structure, image alt tags, open graph tags, canonical links.
WhatsApp Bot Simulation / Integration: #AUDIT command via Fast2SMS with instant score notification and compliance alerts.

Drop-in Embeddable JavaScript Widget (Shadow DOM panel): high contrast modes, dyslexia font toggle (OpenDyslexic), text resizing, line spacing, cursor enlarger, screen reader TTS / Sarvam Indic STT voice control mode, focus highlight mode, auto AI vision image alt fixer.
instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive components (buttons, toggles, form inputs, modals, cards, tabs) have unique `data-testid` attributes.

Do NOT rely on generic grey default styles. Use crisp 1px borders, high contrast ratios (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text), and focus ring indicators (`focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-emerald-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2`).

For the Drop-in Widget: Render inside a Shadow DOM or isolated scope so website CSS doesn't bleed into it. Include toggles for: Contrast (Invert, Dark, High Contrast, Monochromatic), Text Size (100% - 200%), Font (Default, OpenDyslexic, Sans, Mono), Spacing, Voice Navigation (Indic STT/TTS), Keyboard Highlight, and Live axe-core scanner button.
Use Lucide-react or Phosphor Icons for accessible icon buttons with explicit `aria-label` tags.
Ensure Sonner toast notifications notify users when audit completes, script is copied, or email/WhatsApp reports are dispatched.
Make sure every chart uses accessible color palettes with clear legends and tooltips.
